description: This file defines the ReadableOrderProduct class, which extends OrderProductEntity and implements Serializable. It represents a product within an order with attributes like product name, SKU, image, price, and subtotal, including getters and setters for each.

classes.name: ReadableOrderProduct
classes.description: A class representing a readable view of an order product, including product details such as name, SKU, image, price, and subtotal.

methods.name: getProductName
methods.description: Returns the name of the product.

methods.name: setProductName
methods.description: Sets the name of the product.

methods.name: getSku
methods.description: Returns the SKU of the product.

methods.name: setSku
methods.description: Sets the SKU of the product.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Returns the image URL or identifier.

methods.name: setImage
methods.description: Sets the image URL or identifier.

methods.name: getPrice
methods.description: Returns the price of the product as a String.

methods.name: setPrice
methods.description: Sets the price of the product.

methods.name: getSubTotal
methods.description: Returns the subtotal amount for this product.

methods.name: setSubTotal
methods.description: Sets the subtotal amount for this product.
